comments.anchorText: Hanc deus et melior litem natura diremit.
comments.body: Both Deus ("quisquis deum..." whoever of the gods it was...) and melior natura (nature meaning natural processes; melior meaning better than the chaos that came before) are what assembled the world. Thus the Stoics who demanded a Demiurge were satisfied, and the Epicureans too, who said it was Nature. Ovid had it both ways.
